bio.text: J.D. Ford, a Democrat, represents District 29 in the Indiana Senate, having defeated Republican Sen. Mike Delph in 2018.
He won the Democratic nomination for Indiana's 5th Congressional District in the May 5, 2026 primary and faces Republican Rep. Victoria Spartz in November.
Ford is an Indianapolis resident with a bachelor's degree in criminal justice from the University of Akron and a master's degree in education from Purdue University Northwest.

sources.title: Democratic state senator announces 5th District campaign to unseat Spartz
